Definition: from G5613 and G5037; so too, i.e. thus therefore (in various relations of consecution, as follow):--(insomuch) as, so that (then), (insomuch) that, therefore, to, wherefore.
BiblicalUsage: In the New Testament, hṓste is the word for so that, therefore. In Matthew 8:24, the text says "insomuch that the ship was covered with the waves."
TheologicalSignificance: This one, hṓste, I take at face value: so that, therefore.
RelatedTopics: Word of God; Faith; Christian Life
RelatedEvents: Jesus Calms the Storm; Jesus Heals a Demoniac in the Capernaum Synagogue
